titre: Pertes déclarées pour fraude aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Milliards de dollars déclarés par les consommateurs, 2023 à 2025

2023.texte: consumers reported losing more than $10 billion to fraud in 2023, marking the first time that fraud losses have reached that benchmark

2024.texte: consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024

2025.texte: Crooks and con artists stole a record $15.9 billion in 2025 in a variety of scams
